functions.evidence: Runtime sandbox initialization calls this import with name rd, a stack buffer and length16. The original wrapper forwards name/buffer/length to PE_parse_boot_argn_internal using BootArgs.CommandLine+0x6c and string mode TRUE (w4=1), matching pinned Apple pexpert/gen/bootargs.c PE_parse_boot_arg_str. Its tail target is already paired to that internal parser. The native board wrapper preserves the interface and adds PE_builtin_boot_args fallback, explaining its different shape. Hardware panic and exact chain evidence: sandbox-bootarg-binding-20261031.json.

Original get/set wrappers null-check and tail-call the already identified IORegistryEntry implementation; serializeProperties copies/serializes the property dictionary. The native methods preserve CPU-state behavior.
